content.text:
I submitted **index 3 (Sb fraction 0.33)** as the best composition. Its EQE of **0.0368%** was the highest of the five I measured. All 5 EQE measurements and 4 of the 5 XRD measurements are used.

| Index | Sb fraction | EQE (%) |
|---|---|---|
| 0 | 0.264 | 0.0081 |
| **3** | **0.330** | **0.0368** |
| 4 | 0.362 | 0.0309 |
| 8 | 0.502 | 0.0111 |
| 13 | 0.657 | 0.00025 |

- **EQE trend:** EQE rises from the low-Sb end, peaks around Sb 0.33, then falls steeply. By Sb 0.66 the film is essentially inactive.
- **XRD:** Indices 2, 3 and 4 (Sb 0.305–0.362) look like a single pyrochlore-type phase, and the lattice shrinks slightly as Sb increases. At index 6 (Sb 0.43), a new peak appears near Q ≈ 3.22 and the peak heights shift, which points to a second phase forming. These phase labels are my reading of the peak positions, not a confirmed identification.

Index 2 (Sb 0.305) was never EQE-measured, so the true peak could sit slightly below 0.33. My last EQE measurement went to index 4 instead, because the curve showed EQE still reasonably high at the next step up from 0.33. Its result, 0.0309%, came in below index 3.
